title: Flamenco Show is Spectacular
text: I came with my family to watch the Flamenco show. We all enjoyed the show including my teenager son and my 3 year old daughter. The singers and the Flamenco dancers were amazing. The sound, the music, their singer voices and their dancers were spectacular. 100 recommend the show for families. The venue is cozy and the drinks were really good. If you are in doubt, book this show. It is AMAZING!
